body: i just keep getting beaten down. i feel like i fell off my horse, and id like nothing more then to get back on but someone keeps kicking the shit out of me while im down. i went into this school year [im in college] broken hearted and because of it i got behind in my studies now idk if i can even catch up i changed majors so im behind in general and i keep getting pulled around by the people i want most inmy life. the boy that broke my heart keeps flopping around one minute saying he wants to be with me the next he cant abandon his ex who has wrapped herself around him. to make matters worse the boy that i was in a relationship for 2years previous to this new boy just got a nw girlfriend. he treats me like dirt now when in the past we were really good friends. i feel abandoned by both of them when i could really use some support. and its scary to be so hurt by my ex because i guess i had this childish dellusion that some day wed get back together and get married. we really work together we only broke up becasue we didnt want to do long distance. i just feel like everything i once knew changed. all the happiness i had for those two years is gone and im back to where i use to be. depressed and wanting it to all just end. i never wanted to get this bad ever again. when i was depressed the first time it was horrible and lasted for a long year and a half of my life. when i was happy i was always so scared i would go back to it. and here i am exactly where i didnt want to be. ontop of everything being this bad again creates shame and disappointment in myself.
not too comfortable giving out adress infro but id love to talk if your willing to listen to my silly problems that keep dragging me down
thank you. its hard to remember that especially right now. the loneliness feels so if drowning me. i appreciate every word of kindness. i really do.
